sources.label: Official Pull&Bear product-page Measurements, Body tab (cm), women's fitted t-shirt
Official Pull&Bear product-page Measurements, Body tab (cm), women's slim-fit long sleeve t-shirt

audit: Old URL pullandbear.com/uk/help/size-guide not used (UK store is /gb/; no general size guide page found). Product-page 'See measurements' > Body tab prints one chest/waist/hip value per size (cm, 'The measurements shown refer to body measurements'); identical on two women's tops. Letters only: UK/US/EU removed (not printed). XXL removed (not offered/printed). Old M 89/71/94 -> chest 92, waist 74, hip 100; old XL 101/83/106 -> 105/87/113.
